cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Dr. and Mrs. Robert Wetmore, The Country Club of North Carolina, Pinehurst, North Carolina, 1961; Descended in family; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6568, lot no. 112, 25 May 1994 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . No signature" [note of inscription]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Initials in circle" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Sold by Halpert to Wetmore, 12–61." Whitney Archive indicates no. 47 in 1924 exhibition. Backing inscription dates 1921. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1921 and 1923. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: An enlarged view of a blackish purple fig on its side with a bright red pear behind. The fruits sit on a white surface with a textured green background. Loose brushwork is visible throughout.
